toolchainProfile.policy: Exact locked profile is mandatory. Version drift, host-architecture drift, and dependency drift fail before build.

included: AOSP-compatible framework behavior covered by Android compatibility requirements
notClaimedUntilScopeExpands: hardware-feature behavior not used by the bootstrap shell
WebView behavior because WebView is not used
network behavior because INTERNET permission and network code are not used
native/JNI behavior because no native payload is loaded

R1.reason: Kernel bootstrap, compatibility decisions, exception and external input semantics are executable.

R2.reason: Main-thread, shared-state synchronization, StrictMode, memory growth, responsiveness and resource budgets apply to every process.

R3.reason: Activity lifecycle, recreation, background/resume and process restart are executable.

R4.reason: Bootstrap shell contains no durable database, file, DataStore, preferences, cache source-of-truth, backup or migration path. Introduction of any persistent store invalidates this closure.

R5.reason: Launcher Activity is exported and therefore an external boundary; network and dangerous permission universes are closed empty.

R6.reason: All APK build, dependency, manifest, shrink, signing, install and provenance rules apply.

R7.reason: Bootstrap APK loads no native library, external plugin, dynamic code or reflection-generated entry point. Introduction of any such path invalidates this closure.

R8.reason: Bootstrap UI, configuration, accessibility, startup, frame rendering and Android 11 ARM64 device behavior apply. WebView and hardware feature universes are closed empty.

R9.reason: Final evidence, fault ownership, stale-proof and unknown closure are mandatory.

ASSET.reason: Manifest/package and generated Android resources remain subject to asset/package proof even though custom app assets are intentionally minimized.
